skill_name: Summarize the steps in creating an e-commerce website.
workflow: Creating an e-commerce website involves several steps including setting up the domain name, choosing a hosting provider, installing the requisite software, designing the site, setting up and configuring a payment gateway, and setting up a content management system. Additionally, you will need to pick a template, add product information and images, ensure the checkout process is secure, optimize the website for SEO, and set up customer service options.
